mapper.select: select s.id, s.name, s.code, s.college_id, c.name as college_name from speciality s join college c on c.id = s.college_id where s.id = #{id}
select s.id, s.name, s.code, s.college_id, c.name as college_name from speciality s join college c on c.id = s.college_id order by s.id desc
select id, name, code, college_id as collegeId from speciality order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into speciality(name, code, college_id) values(#{name}, #{code}, #{collegeId})
